name: Waseem Tariq
role: Full Stack Java Engineer · Software Developer
headline: Building production software. Learning by shipping.
introduction: Full Stack Java Engineer building real products with Java/Spring Boot microservices, Next.js frontends, and cloud deployment. I work with NexGenDevelopers on end-to-end software delivery, while completing a BCA at LPU and pursuing applied-AI research in healthcare discovery.
careerStory: My path into software engineering is built on real delivery. I design and build backend systems with Java and Spring Boot, deploy them to Linux VPS infrastructure with Docker and Nginx, and connect them to modern React frontends. Alongside engineering work, I am completing an online BCA at Lovely Professional University and developing research in applied AI for healthcare service discovery.
researchTopic: Reliable AI-Assisted Healthcare Service Discovery Using Semantic Retrieval and Constraint Validation
researchSummary: A research direction exploring semantic retrieval, deterministic constraint validation, uncertainty handling, and comparison against keyword-based search using synthetic healthcare-service data and manually labelled queries.

experience.summary: Building and deploying full-stack products with a focus on Java/Spring Boot backend engineering, microservices architecture, and modern web frontends. Delivered a live production platform for an educational institute from zero to deployment.
highlights: Designed and deployed Spring Boot microservices with Spring Cloud Gateway and Eureka service discovery
PostgreSQL / Neon database integration with Docker and Docker Compose
Nginx reverse proxy, Linux VPS deployment, domain configuration, and HTTPS
Next.js / React frontend integration — shipped live to production

experience.summary: Five years in a structured public-sector role, developing strong professional discipline, process awareness, and accountability. This experience runs alongside technical development and sharpens how I approach complex, real-world systems.
highlights: Professional discipline in formal, high-accountability environments
Systems thinking shaped by structured processes and real-world constraints

education.detail: Pursuing formal computer-applications education alongside active software engineering projects and AI research.
Completed four semesters of rigorous Computer Science & Engineering coursework, establishing a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, discrete mathematics, and systems architecture.
